description: Masala Maggi Noodles are a beloved Indian comfort food, transforming instant noodles into a flavorful, spicy, and satisfying meal. This quick and easy dish is packed with aromatic spices and fresh vegetables, making it a delicious twist on a classic snack. Perfect for a quick lunch or a late-night craving, it is a staple in many Indian households.

instructions.title: Prepare Vegetables
instructions.text: Begin by finely chopping the onion, tomato, and capsicum. Slit the green chili lengthwise. Have all your spices measured out and ready for quick addition.

instructions.title: Sauté Aromatics
instructions.text: Heat oil in a medium-sized pan or kadai over medium heat. Add the cumin seeds and let them splutter for a few seconds. Then, add the chopped onion and green chili and sauté until the onion turns translucent and soft, about 3-4 minutes.

instructions.title: Add Tomatoes and Spices
instructions.text: Now, add the finely chopped tomatoes to the pan. Cook them, stirring occasionally, until they soften and release their juices, forming a pulpy mixture. Stir in the turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, and garam masala. Cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the raw smell of the spices disappears.

instructions.title: Incorporate Vegetables
instructions.text: Add the chopped capsicum and peas to the pan. Sauté for another 2-3 minutes, allowing the vegetables to cook slightly while still retaining a pleasant crunch. This adds texture and freshness to the noodles.

instructions.title: Cook the Maggi Noodles
instructions.text: Pour the water into the pan and bring it to a rolling boil. Break the Maggi noodle cakes into smaller pieces and add them to the boiling water along with the Maggi taste maker sachets from the packets. Stir everything well to ensure the noodles are submerged and the taste maker is evenly distributed.

instructions.title: Simmer and Serve
instructions.text: Reduce the heat to low, cover the pan, and let the noodles simmer for 3-4 minutes, or until the noodles are perfectly cooked and most of the water has been absorbed, leaving a saucy consistency. Garnish generously with fresh chopped coriander and serve your delicious Masala Maggi Noodles immediately while hot.

tips: To achieve a richer flavor, toast the cumin seeds briefly before adding onions until fragrant.
For extra protein, add scrambled egg or paneer cubes along with the vegetables.
Adjust the amount of water to your preference; less water for drier noodles, more for a soupier consistency.
